title: Standing Instruction of the Agronomy Plant: Prescription, Licensing and Re-Entry Figures for Custom Application and Field Services
content:
1. Of the six programmes of Custom Application and Field Services, the catalogue marks two as requiring a current variable-rate prescription and four as not. Where a prescription is required, it stays current for the programme's validity period, counted in calendar days from the day the prescription was written.

2. A soil test stays current for the programme's soil test validity, counted in months. Where a programme carries a validity of 0 months, no soil test currency figure is set on that programme.

3. Four of the six programmes require the applicator licence to be verified, and the same four are the programmes on which restricted-use product may be applied.

4. The field is closed after application for the programme's re-entry interval, counted in hours.

| Programme | Prescription required | Prescription stays current for (calendar days) | Soil test stays current for (months) | Applicator licence verification required | Restricted-use product allowed | Re-entry interval (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | No | 0 | 0 | No | No | 12 |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | No | 0 | 0 | No | No | 12 |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | No | 0 | 48 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | Yes | 365 | 36 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | Yes | 365 | 36 | Yes | Yes | 12 |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | No | 0 | 48 | Yes | Yes | 24 |

5. Two consequences follow from the table as it stands. A programme may require the licence to be verified and permit restricted-use product without requiring any prescription at all, which is the position on the Full-Service Agronomy Plan and on the Certified Anhydrous Application Plan. And a programme may set a soil test currency figure without requiring a prescription, which is again the position on those two, at 48 months.

6. The Certified Anhydrous Application Plan is the only programme of Custom Application and Field Services on which the field stands closed for 24 hours after a pass; on the other five the interval is 12 hours.
